positive_prompt: Conté crayon velvety hatching, chiaroscuro shaping without hard outline, paper-texture highlights and controlled mid-tones, soft edge dissolution; translate only the photographed subject through the reference's crayon handling.
negative_prompt: Do not copy portrait, figure, interior, or composition. No hard ink outline, no invented background, no Starbucks logo, no text, no hand.

line.character: no hard line, hatching builds form

edges.subject: soft dissolved edge via hatching, no contour

finishing_notes: use reference only for Conté hatching and tonal shaping

mark_edge_quality: velvety Conté hatching, no hard line
chiaroscuro volume via tone, not outline
negative_space_rules: preserve paper grain and highlight around subject
fill_tonal_rules: build volume with layered hatching from mid-tone to dark
background_cleanliness: empty areas match shared paper master with subtle grain
no speckle field or backing patch
sample_style_contract_defaults.frame_border_policy: forbid generated frames, borders, crop edges, and plate seams
sample_style_contract_defaults.abstraction_level: Conté tonal simplification that preserves source identity and imports no portrait
